title: Sync jam: product + eng + applied-ml roadmap prep (scratch)
content:
Goal: rapid, low-friction alignment between Product, Eng and Applied ML for the next 3-month rollouts. This is a scratchpad for the 30–45m cross-functional jam (informal) — capture open questions, constraints, and immediate action items we can land in the next week.

Meeting framing (30–45m):
- 5m: quick status (where each team is at: product priorities, infra constraints, eval signals)
- 15m: concrete tradeoffs (latency vs cost vs quality) for two candidate initiatives: 1) Quantized 7B as primary offering for mid-market customers, 2) Dedicated burst capacity for Priority customers
- 10m: rollout mechanics (canary plan, telemetry, rollback triggers)
- 5–15m: open issues / decisions + assign owners

Current state (one-liners):
- Product: wants a lightweight 7B offering by mid-July to reduce per-token price for trial users; primary success metric = 25% lower unit cost while maintaining > 0.95 quality parity on prompt set A.
- Eng (runtime): prototype quantized path exists (PR 1892) but needs kernel tuning for long-context (>1k) sequences; perf regression at 8k sequences.
- Applied ML: evals show small quality drop on safety prompts with 4-bit quant; have suggestions for targeted calibration/LoRA to recover.

Key constraints to surface in sync: (bring specific numbers if you can)
- Throughput SLO: 99th p95 token latency target 150ms for interactive tier; current quantized path sits at ~190ms under our default batching.
- Cost target: host unit cost reduction target = 30% vs current fp16 baseline.
- Capacity: limited spare GPU headroom in us-west-2 the week of July 4; may need region fallback.
- Eval coverage: Product wants production-representative prompt set A (200 prompts) to be used as gating for rollout. Applied ML to confirm gate pass/fail criteria.

Open questions to resolve in jam (prep answers):
- Which degradation signal will trigger rollback? (quality delta on prompt set A > 5%, or safety failure count > N) — proposed: quality delta + safety threshold.
- Can we accept slightly higher p99 latency during canary if cost drops significantly? (Product prefers bounded latency; Eng suggests temporary relaxation for canary only).
- Who owns end-to-end telemetry dashboard for the canary? (SRE + Product analytics?)
- Is there a short-term prompt-rewriting band-aid we can include to mitigate quant artifacts while calibration is ongoing? (Applied ML suggests two templated rewrites)

Proposed decisions to surface (fast track):
1) Adopt the 7B quantized offering as "beta" for trials if applied-ml certifies prompt-set A pass (owner: Product — Sofia; gating: pass quality parity >= 0.95).
2) Canary window: 2 weeks, 10% of traffic routed to quantized variant, then 50% for 1 week if no regressions. Rollback triggers: quality delta > 5% OR safety incidents > 3 in 24h (owner: Eng — Arjun).
3) Telemetry: create a cross-team dashboard capturing token-latency percentiles, token-cost, quality delta on prompt set A, safety incidents, and alert on thresholds (owner: SRE + Applied ML liaison — Noah).

Short checklist / action items (assign now):
- [ ] Product: finalize trial pricing + legal blurb for beta docs (Sofia) — due 2026-06-02
- [ ] Applied ML: run full prompt-set A calibration w/ 4-bit + LoRA suggestions; produce recommended patch and gating metric (Noah) — due 2026-06-04
- [ ] Eng: schedule kernel tuning spike (2 engineers) and provide updated perf numbers for 1k/8k contexts (Arjun) — spike start 2026-05-28, report 2026-06-03
- [ ] SRE/Observability: scaffold canary dashboard, wire alerts to PagerDuty playbook placeholder (Marta) — due 2026-06-05
- [ ] Docs: draft short "beta" FAQ + release notes template (Ivy) — due 2026-06-07

Risks & mitigations (notes):
- Risk: safety regressions with quantized path. Mitigation: gated canary + safety-only rollback; add runtime prompt filters temporarily.
- Risk: throughput SLO miss. Mitigation: temporary traffic cap + region fallback to fp16 nodes.
- Risk: evaluation not representative. Mitigation: include small shadow traffic sampling during canary to expand eval coverage.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Bring PR 1892 perf table to sync (copy slices for 512/1024/8192 token lengths).
- Remind Applied ML to attach sample-generated outputs for top 10 safety prompts.
- Consider a short "engineering-only" dry run before public beta (internal beta with platform teams).

Post-meeting follow-up template (quick):
- Decision log: list adopted items (owner + reason)
- Tasks: populate Linear tickets with owners and due dates (I will create placeholders immediately after meeting)
- Communication: short announcement draft for #prod-announcements + customer-success draft for pilot cohort

Scratchpad end.

Unresolved / parking-lot:
- Need cost model breakdown per token for quantized 7B across us-west-2 vs eu-west-1. (Finance input?)
- Legal compliance check for data residency if we use eu region fallback for EU customers.

Quick references (for meeting):
- Linear: ML-412 (onboarding plan), ENG-2031 (kernel spike)
- GH: runtime PR 1892 (quantized path)
- Confluence: /team/applied-ml/quant-profiles (calibration notes)

End of scratch.
